disposition: The original unchanged-Piper assertion was overbroad for a schema-v1 profile without downloaded voice assets. The observed Piper-to-Kokoro migration is the existing intended main behavior, not an introduced Gateway voice migration.
staticEvidence: The SettingsManager feature diff adds only the UseGatewayVoice property. Existing main tests explicitly expect schema-v1/unloaded Piper to become Kokoro and downloaded Piper or schema-v2 chosen Piper to remain Piper.
limits: Do not claim every old provider preference stays identical. No downloaded-Piper runtime upgrade was exercised; no fake model assets were created. No installer upgrade is claimed.
